pages.title: At Her Bedside
pages.text: Enable your maid’s chat bubbles and let her sleep in a bed on a day or night shift. Her lines are drawn from a built-in set and work with AI chat turned off. The all-day schedule and the Lazy Maid task skip sleep dialogue.

pages.title: Bedtime Chatter
pages.text: Give two of your maids beds within 8 blocks of each other. Day-shift maids chat from 10 pm to 1 am in game time. Night-shift maids chat from 6 to 9 am. Each sleeper has a chance to speak every 10–20 seconds.

pages.title: Eavesdropping
pages.text: Walk within 5 blocks of either sleeper and the group falls silent. Sneak up to listen. You can release sneak if you stand still. If they notice you, stay more than 5 blocks from every sleeper for 10 seconds so they can resume.

pages.title: Easing Fear
pages.text: Each bedtime chat bubble lowers the speaker’s Fear of you by 1. Each maid can lose up to 5 Fear per shift per Minecraft day this way. A maid at 0 Fear keeps her remaining allowance.

pages.title: Dreaming Alone
pages.text: Outside those hours, even a lone sleeper may talk in her sleep every 25–45 seconds. Dreams leave Trust and Fear unchanged. When she wakes, she may speak once if you are within 8 blocks, or 5 during chatter hours.

pages.title: A Bad Dream
pages.text: Subtract her Trust in you from her Fear of you. The difference gives the chance that her next dream line is a nightmare.$(br2)Below 0: 10%$(br)0–25: 30%$(br)26–50: 50%$(br)51–75: 70%$(br)76 or more: 90%
